lead.event: Mirae Asset recommends accumulative buys and sets targets for four Indonesian banks
lead.headline: Mirae recommends accumulative buys on four banks, sets BBCA target at Rp6,775
lead.blurb: Nafan Aji Gusta's per-share targets are Rp4,230 for BNI, Rp5,375 for Bank Mandiri, Rp6,775 for BCA and Rp3,360 for BRI. He said the 25-basis-point rate increase to 6% supports rupiah stability and could restore positive sentiment toward banking stocks, alongside controlled NPL levels and credit growth within BI and OJK's 10%-12% YoY target range.

deals_control.event: AKR Corporindo agrees to acquire Vivo Energy Indonesia and Nusantara Karya Oranye
deals_control.headline: AKRA agrees to acquire Vivo Energy Indonesia and NKO for US$15.5 million
deals_control.blurb: AKR Corporindo, through subsidiary Aneka Petroindo Raya and with Petro Palma Persada, signed a conditional share purchase agreement with three Singapore-based sellers. After completion, Aneka Petroindo Raya will hold 90% of each company and Petro Palma Persada the remaining 10%, with Vivo fuel stations set to join the BP-AKR retail network.

earnings_guidance.event: Semen Indonesia reports a 363% increase in 9M2026 net profit
earnings_guidance.headline: SMGR reports 363% increase in 9M2026 net profit to Rp531.84 billion
earnings_guidance.blurb: SIG's revenue rose 9.3% year on year to Rp27.67 trillion on sales of 27.87 million tons, while EBITDA increased 8.4% to Rp3.56 trillion and net financial expenses fell 37.0%. Since June, its subsidiary Solusi Bangun Indonesia has exported more than 300,000 tons of special-type cement to the United States through a partnership with Taiheiyo Cement.
